Description

Double-buffered amplitude configuration. Writes take effect when ENABLE is written.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[15:8] - - - -

[3:0] amplitude_div_linear rw 0x8 -

Field Descriptions

amplitude_div_log

Logarithmic amplitude divider. The output is divided by 2^(15-b).

amplitude_div_linear

Linear amplitude divider. The output is about a/15 of full scale.
